name: Hattush
overview: Hattush is a male figure noted in the biblical record for his role in the restoration of Jerusalem. He is specifically recognized for making repairs to the wall of Jerusalem as recorded in Nehemiah 3:10. There is no information about his tribal affiliation or additional personal notes.
namesAndTitles: The name Hattush appears once in Scripture without a provided meaning or special title. It is presented simply as a proper name in Nehemiah 3:10.
familyAndRelationships: Hattush is identified as the son of Hashabneiah according to Nehemiah 3:10. Beyond this, Scripture does not record any other family relationships for him.
scriptureSignificance: Hattush's significance lies in his contribution to the physical and spiritual restoration of Jerusalem after the exile. By participating in the rebuilding of the city’s walls, he played a part in reestablishing the security and identity of God's people. His work exemplifies faithful service in the communal effort to restore the city under divine guidance.
